description: Sync context file templates before each session, scope the advisor's Bash access, and persist session history to Hindsight on session end. All hooks self-scope to agent_type == "over-50s-health:advisor" in bash (never in a prompt) and no-op for every other session, because Claude Code plugin hooks apply plugin-wide with no declarative per-agent matcher. Retention and the staleness check register on both SubagentStop (the event a subagent advisor actually fires) and Stop (an explicit `claude --agent` main session); the retain is idempotent, so both firing is harmless.
